case_title.quote: DR. VINOD BHANDARI v. STATE OF M.P.

number_of_accused.quote: there are in all 516 accused out of which 329 persons have been arrested

accused_gender.reason: Gender not explicitly stated; judgment only uses 'Dr.' and 'he'. Acceptable as Not stated.

accused_occupation.quote: Managing Director of Shri Aurbindo Institute of Medical Sciences, Indore

previous_criminal_record.correct_value: Prosecuted for another similar offence (FIR No.14 of 2013, 8 other candidates); granted anticipatory bail there
previous_criminal_record.quote: is also prosecuted for another offence of similar type of having sponsored 8 other candidates
previous_criminal_record.reason: Judgment mentions another similar case against him.

offence_category.correct_value: Cheating/forgery/criminal conspiracy in medical entrance exam admissions (corruption scam)
offence_category.quote: Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B of the Indian Penal Code
offence_category.reason: Criminal breach of trust is not charged; offences are cheating, forgery, conspiracy.

statutory_provisions.quote: Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B of the Indian Penal Code ("IPC") read with Section 3(d), 1, 2/4 of the Madhya Pradesh Manyata Prapt Pariksha Adhiniyam, 1937 and under Sections 65 and 66 of the l.T. Act

evidence_type.correct_value: Documentary (excel sheet, seized documents, hard disc), recovery of cash, co-accused memoranda, s.164 statement; no medical evidence
evidence_type.quote: The certified copy of the excel sheet of the data retrieved from the hard disc
evidence_type.reason: 'Medical' evidence is not present; 'circumstantial' is loose.

confession.correct_value: Disclosure statement by co-accused Pradeep Raghuvanshi leading to recovery; memorandums of other accused
confession.quote: disclosure statement was made by Pradeep Raghuvanshi which led to the recovery of money and documents

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: Large scale conspiracy, huge money, kingpin role, potential to influence witnesses, went abroad after FIR
aggravating_circumstances.quote: the role of the applicant is being part of the conspiracy and is the kingpin

mitigating_circumstances.correct_value: Prolonged custody of about one year with no prospect of immediate trial; anticipatory bail in other FIR
mitigating_circumstances.quote: the appellant has been in custody for about one year and there is no prospect of immediate trial
mitigating_circumstances.reason: Delay in trial was a recognized consideration.

trial_court_outcome.quote: considered by the 9th Additional Sessions Judge, Bhopal and dismissed vide Order dated 9.5.2014

high_court_outcome.quote: High Court dismissed the bail application filed by the appellant

final_outcome.correct_value: Appeal disposed of; bail declined, with liberty to apply afresh if trial not completed within one year
final_outcome.quote: The appeal is accordingly disposed of with the above observations.
final_outcome.reason: No acquittal; only bail matter decided.

offence_finally_established.correct_value: Not determined; no trial finding, bail stage only
offence_finally_established.quote: observations in our above judgment will not be treated as expression of any opinion on merits
offence_finally_established.reason: 'None' wrongly implies finding; merits not decided.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Facts without outcome claims or invented details; no 'loss to State exchequer' finding in this case
neutral_facts.quote: The offences alleged are economic offences which have resulted in loss to the State exchequer.
neutral_facts.reason: Last sentence about financial loss comes from quoted precedent, not this case; otherwise broadly accurate.

offence_severity.quote: the offence is punishable with life sentence
offence_severity.reason: High Court noted life sentence punishment.

attempt_completion.quote: 7 candidates out of aforesaid candidates were got passed by using unfair means

number_of_offences.correct_value: Two FIRs (No.12 and No.14 of 2013); 516 accused is not offence count
number_of_offences.quote: FIR No.14 of 2013 registered on 20th November, 2013
number_of_offences.reason: Value gives accused counts, not number of offences.

financial_property_loss.correct_value: Appellant allegedly received few crores of rupees; Rs.60 lakh cash seized
financial_property_loss.quote: The appellant received few crores of rupees in the process from undeserving candidates
financial_property_loss.reason: Money amounts are stated; 'Not applicable' is wrong.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Alleged (by charge sheet), not found by the Supreme Court: well-designed conspiracy
premeditation_planning.quote: committed a serious crime in well designed conspiracy
premeditation_planning.reason: This was an allegation in the charge-sheet, not a court finding.

motive.correct_value: Monetary gain alleged (money received from candidates for admissions)
motive.quote: for monetary consideration helped the undeserving students
motive.reason: Money-driven motive is evident from the allegations.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: Court only found allegations supported by material on record at bail stage; no evidence accepted as proof
key_evidence_accepted.quote: when the allegations are supported by material on record
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Overstates; prima facie only, expressly no opinion on merits.

witness_credibility.quote: observations in our above judgment will not be treated as expression of any opinion on merits
witness_credibility.reason: No witness credibility assessment is made.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: High Court noted he went abroad after FIR and returned only after anticipatory bail; Supreme Court did not itself rely on it
post_offence_conduct.quote: going abroad soon after the registration of the Crime No.12/2013 and returning back to India on 21.1.2014
post_offence_conduct.reason: Fact correct but 'attempt to avoid arrest' was the State's contention.

custody_duration.quote: the appellant has been in custody for about one year

bail_history.correct_value: Anticipatory bail in FIR 14/2013 (16.1.2014); first bail in this case rejected 5.2.2014, second rejected 9.5.2014, HC rejected
bail_history.quote: first bail application had been dismissed on 5th February, 2014
bail_history.reason: Omits rejections in this case; value suggests bail granted.

trial_duration.reason: Dates given are accurate; trial not yet begun.

legal_representation.quote: Siddharth Luthra, H. P. Raval, Kunal Verma, Keki Vajpei, Prasanna Mohan, Anando Mukherjee for the Appellant

investigation_status.correct_value: Charge sheets filed in part; investigation still pending, final charge sheet due by March 15, 2015
investigation_status.quote: certain aspects are still being investigated

appeal_history.correct_value: Bail denied by trial court and High Court; Supreme Court disposed of appeal, upholding denial with directions
appeal_history.quote: The appeal is accordingly disposed of with the above observations.
appeal_history.reason: 'Dismissed' is imprecise; disposed of with directions.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: State urged no interference: prima facie case, life sentence, kingpin, could influence witnesses, investigation pending, went abroad; excel sheet and s.164 statement
prosecution_argument.quote: the appellant was the kingpin in the conspiracy, he had the potential of influencing the witnesses
prosecution_argument.reason: Value borrows from precedent text and misstates arguments.

defence_argument.quote: the appellant cannot be kept in custody for indefinite period before his guilt is established

legal_principle_applied.quote: The object of keeping a person in custody is to ensure his availability to face the trial

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Kalvan Chandra Sarkar vs. Rajesh Ranjan, State of U.P. vs. Amarmani Tripathi, State of Kerala vs. Raneef and Sanjay Chandra vs. CBI

judicial_mitigating_factors.correct_value: Custody of about one year and no prospect of immediate trial; speedy trial right
judicial_mitigating_factors.quote: It is certainly a matter of serious concern that the appellant has been in custody for about one year

judicial_aggravating_factors.correct_value: Serious adverse impact on society, high magnitude, depravity, black money, undermining trust in medical profession
judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: the offence alleged against the appellant has serious adverse impact on the fabric of the society

other_sentence_order.quote: if the trial is not completed within one year from today for reasons not attributable to the appellant, the appellant will be entitled to apply for bail afresh
other_sentence_order.reason: Accurate; investigation deadline was earlier directed by this Court.
